identity.name: Master Control Date
identity.one_liner: The Master Control Date in steel with the new in-house 899/1 calibre — JLC's most-cited Asian entry-haute watch, with a clean sector dial and the Master Control 1000-hour chronometer certification.

provenance_events.description: JLC releases the Master Control Date in steel with the in-house 899/1 automatic calibre.

narrative.story: The Master Control is JLC's most-cited line for the Asian entry-haute market — a 40mm steel dress watch with the in-house 899/1 automatic movement, a clean sector dial, and the Master Control 1000-hour chronometer certification.
narrative.collector_notes: The 1000-hour certification is unique to JLC — it's stricter than COSC.
